town.title: Town Council
town.difficulty: everyday to hard tasks on small accounts
town.planningMode: CLOOP town. One flow, kept by the engine. At every step: `node .cloop/cloop.mjs status` → act → record through the engine → `advance`; the cards status prints carry the detail; a refusal names the next step; never edit cloop/state.json, log.jsonl or board.md by hand. Remove before adding, whole before detail, goal before measure; the size of a change answers the size of the problem. Every loop, shot and phase starts with a prevent: a step back on the whole, then the one-block of the next action (a one-shot is its own block). Climb: the one-shot (the whole product, one file) → council → the next-shot (one small loop: repair and refactor in one block) → the release gate → the user. The council judges every criterion at every step; settle every NOT_MET with a run the engine makes; never shorten a run, a wait or a judging step. The engine computes each outcome and the rung: small (your step back) → full (two loop-breakers) → re-define (the user's comment, then their yes to a re-plan); PASS returns to small. BEST moves only forward. Judges are read-only and blind; loop-breakers write in their own worktrees; builders, when listed, take only build steps. Watch for a spiral and a virtuous cycle. The user is in the loop: ask their decisions in plain words with a recommendation and keep working on the rest. Send `report` after every council and `report --final` first at ACCEPT. After any compaction, reread this file and run `status`.
